title: Putin orders revival of Soviet-era Eurovision rival
description: Instruction to reinstate Intervision follows Russia’s ban from song contest after invasion of Ukraine

title: Ukrainian Strike Hits Command Post in Russia, Causes 'Significant Damage'
description: Ukraine's military reported an air strike from its forces in the Kursk region resulted in "substantial casualties" of Russian troops.

title: Zelenskiy and Trump's Close Coordination on Ukraine War Strategy
description: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has been strengthening ties with President Trump's administration. Discussions include organizing a U.S. delegation's visit and strategies for Ukraine's war efforts against Russia. There's emphasis on U.S. support, investment, and collaboration on critical resources for Ukraine's benefits.

title: Ukraine’s mineral riches have long been eyed by its allies. Now they may be Trump’s price for military aid
description: US President Donald Trump has said he wants access to Ukraine’s mineral deposits in exchange for future military aid that Kyiv needs as it continues to defend itself against Russia’s aggression.

title: 'NKorea troops not fighting in Kursk since mid-Jan'
description: SEOUL — North Korean soldiers previously fighting alongside Russia's army on the Kursk front line appear not to have been engaged in combat since mid-January, South Korea's spy agency told Agence France-Presse (AFP) on Tuesday, after Ukraine claimed they had been withdrawn following heavy losses.

title: Sanctions and Scarcity: Russia's Inflation Dilemma
description: Russia faces climbing inflation rates in December 2024 and January 2025, attributed to Western sanctions, a weakened rouble, and a smaller harvest. The Russian central bank report highlights the economic strains amid ongoing conflict in Ukraine, with inflation predicted to surpass government forecasts.

title: Humanitarian Crisis in Ukraine: The Impact of US Aid Freeze
description: Amidst Ukraine's conflict with Russia, the Pavlohrad concert hall serves as a refuge for displaced civilians. US aid freeze by Donald Trump severely impacts humanitarian efforts. As Ukraine seeks alternative funding, the need for evacuation support and essential services increases amidst relentless Russian bombardments.

title: Trump says he will continue funding Ukraine’s war effort - but he wants something rare in return
description: President Trump says he wants access to Ukraine's supply of rare earth minerals in exchange for American military aid for the country's war against Russia.

title: Lessons from Russia-Ukraine war makes Indian Army seek Active Protection System for T-90 tanks
description: Even though the Russian tanks have been modernised with explosive reactive armour to mitigate threats from shoulder-fired missiles, they remain vulnerable to tandem warheads.

title: Why is Trump’s preferential treatment of Russia shifting? Because there’s nothing in it for him
description: Donald Trump’s position on Ukraine has shifted over time. His antagonistic relationship with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has seemingly improved. Why?
